title: 집에서 보내는 휴가
intro: 집에서 보내는 휴가는 '집에서 휴가 때 하는 일 묘사 → 휴가 하루 일과 → 기억에 남는 집 휴가 경험 → 여행 vs 집 휴가 장단점 비교' 순서로 자주 출제됩니다. 여름휴가에 연차를 내고 분당 아파트에서 늦잠 자고, 가족과 중앙공원·탄천을 걷고, 금요일 밤처럼 매일 가족 영화를 보는 장면 하나로 거의 모든 질문에 답할 수 있습니다. '1년 내내 회의와 프로젝트로 바쁜 20년차 개발자라 집에서 푹 쉬는 게 최고'라는 이유를 꼭 넣으세요.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장(Okay, let me tell you about ~) → 언제·누구와(여름휴가 연차, 가족 넷) → 집에서 하는 일(늦잠, 브런치, 공원 산책, 카페 독서, 영화) → 집이 좋은 이유 → 마무리 문장(So yeah, that's why I love ~)
하루 일과 질문은 '9시 늦잠 → 가족 브런치 → 오후 중앙공원·동네 카페 → 저녁 같이 요리 → 거실에서 영화' 순서로 고정해 두고 First, Then, After that 으로 연결하세요.
경험 질문은 '2년 전 여름, 비 때문에 근교 나들이를 취소 → 집에서 보드게임·요리 → 대전 부모님이 깜짝 방문' 이야기로 고정하면 감정과 반전을 함께 보여 줄 수 있어요.
비교·의견 질문은 '입장 → 이유 2개(돈·체력) → 내 경험(작년 오사카 여행 후 너무 피곤했던 일) → 결론' 구조로 말하세요.

expressions.en: Okay, let me tell you about how I spend my vacation at home.
expressions.ko: 네, 제가 집에서 휴가를 어떻게 보내는지 말해 볼게요.
expressions.note: 집 휴가 질문의 시작 문장으로 그대로 사용

expressions.en: I take a few days off in the summer.
expressions.note: take a day off / take a few days off: 휴가·연차를 내다

expressions.en: We have a late breakfast together.
We take a walk in Central Park.
I read a book at a cafe near my place.
At night, we watch a movie in the living room.
I'm so busy at work all year.
I don't have to set an alarm.
I finally have time to cook for my family.
expressions.ko: 드디어 가족을 위해 요리할 시간이 생겨요.

expressions.en: Traveling can be expensive and tiring.
expressions.ko: 여행은 돈도 많이 들고 피곤할 수 있어요.
expressions.note: 단점을 말할 때 can be + 형용사로 부드럽게

expressions.en: It's a great way to recharge.
I can finally kick back and do nothing.
expressions.ko: 드디어 느긋하게 아무것도 안 할 수 있어요.

expressions.en: It was a blessing in disguise.
expressions.note: 처음엔 나빠 보였지만 결과가 좋았을 때

expressions.en: So yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.
expressions.ko: 그래서 제가 휴가를 집에서 보내는 걸 정말 좋아해요.

questions.en: You indicated in the survey that you spend your vacations at home. What do you usually do during a vacation at home, and why do you prefer staying home?
questions.ko: 설문에서 휴가를 집에서 보낸다고 하셨습니다. 집에서 휴가를 보낼 때 보통 무엇을 하고, 왜 집에 있는 것을 더 좋아하나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 언제·누구와(여름휴가 연차, 가족) → 하는 일(늦잠, 중앙공원, 카페 독서, 영화) → 집이 좋은 이유(1년 내내 바쁨) → 'So yeah, that's why ~' 마무리
I'm the kind of person who loves ~ 로 나를 소개하고, The main reason is that ~ 으로 이유를 붙이면 구조가 깔끔해져요.
'알람 없이 일어난다', '코드 리뷰도 회의도 없다'처럼 회사 생활과 대비되는 디테일을 넣으세요.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about how I spend my vacation at home. Every summer, I take a few days off. I usually stay home with my family. I sleep in until nine, and we have a late breakfast together. In the afternoon, we take a walk in Central Park. Sometimes I read a book at a cafe near my place. At night, we watch a movie in the living room. I'm really busy at work, so I just want to rest. So yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.
answers.IH: Okay, let me tell you about how I spend my vacation at home. I'm the kind of person who loves relaxing at home on vacation. Every summer, I take about four days off, and I usually stay home with my family. I don't have to set an alarm, so I sleep in until nine. Then we have a big brunch together. In the afternoon, I go to a cafe near my place with a book and an Americano, or we all take a walk in Central Park. In the evening, I finally have time to cook for my family. And of course, we watch a movie in the living room every night. The main reason is that I'm so busy at work all year. I have meetings, code reviews, and deadlines every day. So yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.
answers.AL: Oh, my vacation at home? Sure, let me tell you about it. Honestly, I'm the kind of person who loves relaxing at home on vacation. A lot of my coworkers fly somewhere every summer, but I usually just take four or five days off and stay home with my family. The first thing I do is turn off my alarm. On a normal day, I'm up at six thirty for my jog along Tancheon, so sleeping in until nine feels like a real luxury. After that, we make a big brunch together, usually pancakes and eggs, and nobody is in a rush. In the afternoon, I sometimes sneak off to my favorite cafe near my place with a book and an iced Americano, or the whole family takes a long walk in Central Park. In the evening, I finally have time to cook for my family, which I almost never do during the week. Then we finish the day with a movie in the living room. The main reason is that I'm so busy at work all year. With ten people on my team, my calendar is full of meetings every single day. At home, I can finally kick back and do nothing. So yeah, that's why I love spending my vacation at home.

questions.en: Tell me about a typical day when you are on vacation at home. What do you do from the morning until night, and who do you spend the time with?
questions.ko: 집에서 휴가를 보낼 때의 전형적인 하루에 대해 말해 주세요. 아침부터 밤까지 무엇을 하고, 누구와 시간을 보내나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 아침(늦잠, 브런치) → 오후(공원·카페) → 저녁(요리, 영화) → 누구와·느낌 → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
First, Then, After that, to finish my day 같은 시간 순서 표현으로 하루를 쭉 이어 가세요.
'아들은 게임, 딸은 그림'처럼 가족 한 명 한 명의 모습을 짧게 넣으면 생생해져요.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about a typical day on vacation. I spend most of the day with my family. First, I sleep in until nine. Then, I make brunch for my family. In the afternoon, we take a walk in Central Park or go to a cafe. My kids love getting ice cream. In the evening, we cook dinner together. After that, I usually watch a movie with my family to finish my day. Spending time with my kids helps me recharge. Yeah, that's a typical vacation day for me.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about a typical vacation day at home. I spend almost the whole day with my family, and it's very relaxed. First, I sleep in until nine. Then, I make brunch for my family, usually eggs, toast, and fruit. After brunch, everyone does their own thing for a while. My son plays games, my daughter draws, and I read on the sofa. Around four, when it's a bit cooler, we take a walk in Central Park and get some ice cream. In the evening, we cook dinner together. My kids are in charge of the salad. After that, I usually watch a movie with my family to finish my day. We usually pick an action or animated movie. Spending time with my kids helps me recharge, because I don't see them much during busy weeks. Yeah, that's a typical vacation day for me.
answers.AL: Oh, a typical vacation day? Let me think. Well, it's pretty much the opposite of a work day. On a normal day, I'm out the door by eight thirty and back after seven, so I barely see my kids. On vacation, everything slows down. First, I sleep in until nine. Then, I make brunch for my family. It's usually something simple like eggs, toast, and fruit, but we sit together and take our time. After brunch, everyone kind of does their own thing. My son plays games, my daughter draws in her sketchbook, and I lie on the sofa with a book, which usually turns into a nap. Around four, when the heat dies down a little, we head out to Central Park or walk along Tancheon. The kids always talk me into buying ice cream. In the evening, we cook dinner together. My kids are in charge of the salad, and the kitchen ends up being a total mess, but it's fun. After that, I usually watch a movie with my family to finish my day. Spending time with my kids helps me recharge more than any trip could. Yeah, that's what a typical vacation day looks like for me.

questions.en: Tell me about a memorable vacation you spent at home. When was it, what did you do, and did anyone visit you? Why was it so memorable?
questions.ko: 집에서 보낸 기억에 남는 휴가에 대해 말해 주세요. 언제였고, 무엇을 했으며, 누가 찾아왔나요? 왜 그렇게 기억에 남나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 언제(2년 전 여름휴가) → 원래 계획과 문제(비 때문에 근교 나들이 취소) → 집에서 한 일 + 반전(대전 부모님 깜짝 방문) → 기억에 남는 이유 → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
To my surprise, ~ 문장으로 반전 장면을 강조하세요.
과거 시제(planned, rained, showed up, played)를 끝까지 유지하는 연습을 하세요.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about a memorable vacation at home. Two years ago, I took a week off in the summer. We planned a day trip, but it rained every day. So we stayed home. We played board games and cooked together. On the third day, someone rang the doorbell. To my surprise, my parents came all the way from Daejeon. They brought a big box of peaches. We had a great time together. Yeah, that's my most memorable vacation at home.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about a memorable vacation at home. Two years ago, I took a week off in the summer. We planned a day trip to a valley near Gapyeong, but it rained every single day. The kids were really disappointed, and honestly, so was I. So we stayed home and made the best of it. We played board games, made dumplings, and watched old movies. On the third day, the doorbell rang in the afternoon. To my surprise, my parents were standing there. They came all the way from Daejeon with a big box of peaches. They said they wanted to see their grandkids. My dad taught my son how to play baduk, and my mom cooked her famous kimchi stew. It was such a warm and cozy week. Yeah, that's my most memorable vacation at home.
answers.AL: Oh, a memorable vacation at home? Yes, actually, one comes to mind right away. It was about two years ago. I took a whole week off in the summer, and we had planned a day trip to a valley near Gapyeong. The kids were so excited about swimming in the stream. But then the rainy season hit, and it poured every single day. At first, everyone was in a bad mood, including me. So we decided to make the best of it. We pulled out all our old board games, made dumplings from scratch, and had a movie marathon in the living room. Then, on the third afternoon, the doorbell rang. To my surprise, my parents were standing there, soaking wet and holding a huge box of peaches. They'd taken the train all the way from Daejeon without telling us, because they missed their grandkids. They ended up staying for four days. My dad taught my son how to play baduk, and my mom took over the kitchen with her famous kimchi stew. It turned out to be the best vacation we'd had in years. It was a blessing in disguise, really. Yeah, that's my most memorable vacation at home.

questions.en: Some people like to travel during their vacations, while others prefer to stay home. What are the advantages and disadvantages of each? Which do you prefer and why?
questions.ko: 휴가 때 여행을 좋아하는 사람도 있고, 집에 있는 것을 더 좋아하는 사람도 있습니다. 각각의 장점과 단점은 무엇인가요? 당신은 어느 쪽을 더 좋아하고, 그 이유는 무엇인가요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 여행의 장점과 단점 → 집 휴가의 장점과 단점 → 내 선택과 이유·경험(작년 오사카 여행 후 피곤) → 'All things considered ~' 마무리
On the other hand, ~ 로 반대쪽을 꺼내고, All things considered, I think ~ 로 결론을 내리세요.
여행도 좋아한다는 걸 인정한 뒤 '그래도 나는 집'이라고 말하면 균형 잡힌 의견으로 들려요.

answers.IM3: Oh, traveling or staying home? Let me think. Traveling is exciting. You can see new places and try new food. My kids loved our trip to Osaka last summer. On the other hand, traveling can be expensive and tiring. Staying home is cheap and relaxing, but it can be a little boring. I'm really busy at work, so I just want to rest. All things considered, I think staying home is better for me. Yeah, that's my opinion.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about that. Both have good points. Traveling is exciting because you can see new places, try new food, and make special memories. Last summer, my family went to Osaka, and my kids still talk about Universal Studios. On the other hand, traveling can be expensive and tiring. You have to plan everything, and flights and hotels cost a lot. Staying home is cheap and relaxing. You can sleep in and do whatever you want. The downside is that it can feel a bit boring, and sometimes you end up doing housework. For me, staying home is better, because I'm so busy at work all year. After the Osaka trip, I went back to work more tired than before. All things considered, I think staying home is better for me. Yeah, that's my opinion.
answers.AL: Oh, that's a good question. Let me think. Honestly, I think both have their pros and cons. The biggest advantage of traveling is that you get out of your routine. You see new places, try new food, and make memories that last forever. Last summer, my family went to Osaka, and my kids still talk about Universal Studios almost every week. On the other hand, traveling can be expensive and tiring. With a family of four, flights and hotels add up really fast, and you spend a lot of energy just planning and moving around. Staying home is the opposite. It's cheap, it's easy, and you can actually rest. The only downside is that it can get a little boring, and it's easy to end up doing chores instead of relaxing. For me, though, the choice is pretty clear. I'm so busy at work all year, with meetings and projects every day, so what I really need is rest. After the Osaka trip, I came back to work more exhausted than before I left. So now I save big trips for every few years. All things considered, I think staying home is better for me. Yeah, that's my opinion.

pronunciation.tip: 가운데 '케이'에 강세. v는 윗니로 아랫입술을 살짝 물고 '베이케이션'.
'릴랙싱'에서 '랙'에 강세. 첫 r은 혀를 말아 시작하세요.
'컴프터블' 세 음절처럼 말해요. 'com-for-ta-ble'로 또박또박 끊지 마세요.

patterns.en: I'm the kind of person who loves relaxing at home on vacation.
patterns.ko: 저는 휴가 때 집에서 쉬는 걸 정말 좋아하는 사람이에요.

patterns.en: The main reason is that I'm so busy at work all year.
patterns.ko: 가장 큰 이유는 1년 내내 회사에서 정말 바쁘기 때문이에요.

patterns.en: First, I sleep in until nine. Then, I make brunch for my family.
patterns.ko: 먼저 9시까지 늦잠을 자요. 그다음 가족을 위해 브런치를 만들어요.

patterns.en: After that, I usually watch a movie with my family to finish my day.
patterns.ko: 그다음에는 보통 가족과 영화를 보며 하루를 마무리해요.

patterns.en: Spending time with my kids helps me recharge.
To my surprise, my parents came all the way from Daejeon.
patterns.ko: 놀랍게도 부모님이 대전에서 먼 길을 오셨어요.

patterns.en: On the other hand, traveling can be expensive and tiring.
patterns.ko: 반면에 여행은 돈도 많이 들고 피곤할 수 있어요.

patterns.en: All things considered, I think staying home is better for me.
patterns.ko: 모든 걸 고려하면 저한테는 집에 있는 게 더 좋다고 생각해요.
